summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing a capital increase of 132,421 Class A common shares from RSU exercises under its incentive program, the resulting total share capital of USD 1,025,536.88 across 102,553,688 A-shares, and stake notices from Hafnia Limited and OCM Njord Holdings S.a r.l. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share for a transaction, premium, or closing condition is stated; the RSU subscription prices in DKK are administrative. Routine equity-compensation and shareholder-stake disclosures, not a special situation; watch for accumulation signals.
